decision: Audit read-only first, then one feature program rather than a stack of small PRs
why: The user asked for an audit plus a large data-depth change and a single PR; splitting would multiply review load on one coherent data layer

decision: Use app.pbatour.org legacy ASP surface for per-match scoring instead of declaring the data unavailable
why: Prior research/probe/alt_report.txt claimed only team-league had inning data; direct probe showed the individual tour does too
evidence: GET live_info_setview.asp?PSTCode=68308 returned 396 KB with var gameNumber="139146|1|end,..."; research/probe/v2_setview_68308.html

decision: Parse inning-by-inning turns from contest_result_set_record.asp rather than reconstructing from aggregates
why: The fragment carries per inning, per player 1P/2P/cumulative score, which is exactly "each player turn" from the request
evidence: GET contest_result_set_record.asp?PCGMCode=139146 -> 13 617 bytes, 7 columns, cells comment-labelled 선수1 1P / 선수2 누적점수; research/probe/v2_record.html

decision: Boundary discipline: all HTML parsing lives in one module returning typed shapes with null on unknown shape
why: Upstream is undocumented HTML that can change silently; parsers must fail to an honest empty state, never a guess
evidence: principle-boundary-discipline, existing house style in src/lib/pba/http.ts

decision: Add a fixture-driven parser test script run by plain node on TypeScript sources
why: CI has no test runner and the parsers are the only risky pure logic; node 25 strips types so no new dependency is needed
evidence: npm run lint is tsc only; CI runs lint/build/verify; node v25.5.0

decision: Commit real upstream HTML as fixtures
why: Makes parser tests deterministic and offline, and documents the markup the code depends on

decision: Split pure parsers from transport into *-parse.ts modules
why: Node cannot resolve the extensionless imports Next allows, and the markup contract must be testable without the network
evidence: first test run failed with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND on ./http

decision: Require a published value before accepting a table row as a player
why: The column-heading row is also a list item, so name-matching alone produced a phantom "Player" with zeroes
evidence: parser test "a column heading is never mistaken for a player" failed twice
result: VERIFIED, fixed in scoreboard-parse and bracket-parse

decision: Treat GP99 as a format flag, not a race target
why: Set five of 68308 is published GP99 and 2-1; rendering "Race to 99" invented a rule the sport does not have and put a 2-point set on a 99-point axis
evidence: rendered page showed "Race to 99" on a 2-1 set

decision: Make the scorecard cache TTL a parameter
why: Audit finding 5: one 86400s constant served both the archive and the 20-second live poll, so the live board would redraw around day-old numbers

decision: Request LangCode=en from every scoring-terminal read
why: The default is Korean, so an English site rendered Korean names once the card had data
evidence: probe: same URL with LangCode=en returns "KH Cho | Martinez"

decision: Cap the event match list at 60 with an explicit "show all" link
why: Rendering all 127 matches of a 128-draw produced a 1.9 MB document on a phone
result: VERIFIED, still large but bounded and cached

decision: Fix only the audit findings inside this feature's blast radius; track the rest
why: Audit lists 47 findings, two of them blockers in the failure signal that need a cross-page refactor; half-doing that refactor late in the run risks the build
result: 2 blockers tracked as issues, 6 cheap high-severity fixes landed
